<div class="root t-{{theme}}"><style>*{box-sizing:border-box;margin:0}
.root{position:relative;font-family:Inter,sans-serif;color:#fff;overflow:hidden;--spring:linear(0,.06 2.5%,.22 5.5%,.5 10.5%,.78 16.5%,.94 22%,1.03 28%,1.05 33%,1.04 39%,1.01 48%,.995 58%,1 70%,1);--bounce:linear(0,.25 8%,.7 16%,1 22%,.86 30%,.83 33%,.86 36%,1 44%,.96 50%,.95 52%,.96 54%,1 60%,.99 65%,1 72%,1);--out:cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1)}
.x,.cam{position:absolute;inset:0}
.cam{transform-origin:50% 50%}
@keyframes leave{to{opacity:0;transform:translateY(-28px) scale(1.015);filter:blur(8px)}}
@keyframes push{from{transform:scale(1)}to{transform:scale(1.04)}}
@keyframes lift{from{transform:translate(var(--in-x,0px),var(--in-y,56px))}}
@keyframes clear{from{opacity:0;filter:blur(12px)}}
@keyframes fadein{from{opacity:0}}
@keyframes fadeout{to{opacity:0}}
@keyframes grow{from{transform:scaleX(0)}}
@keyframes growY{from{transform:scaleY(0)}}
@keyframes reveal{from{clip-path:inset(0 100% 0 0)}to{clip-path:inset(0 0 0 0)}}
@keyframes shimmer{from{background-position:0% 0}to{background-position:-200% 0}}
@keyframes tiltY{from{transform:perspective(1600px) translateX(90px) rotateY(-18deg)}}
@keyframes tiltX{from{transform:perspective(1800px) translateY(90px) rotateX(24deg)}}
@keyframes rise3d{from{transform:perspective(2200px) translateY(300px) rotateX(46deg) scale(.82)}}

@keyframes blink{0%,49%{opacity:1}50%,100%{opacity:0}}

@keyframes type{from{max-width:0}}

.r{animation:lift .9s var(--move,var(--spring)) both,clear .6s var(--out) both}

.grad{background:linear-gradient(90deg,{{primary}},{{secondary}},{{primary}});background-size:200% 100%;-webkit-background-clip:text;background-clip:text;color:transparent}
.eyebrow{font-weight:600;font-size:26px;letter-spacing:.32em;color:#9aa4c0}
.mono{font-family:'JetBrains Mono','DejaVu Sans Mono',Consolas,monospace}

  --display:'Instrument Serif',Georgia,serif;--body:Inter,sans-serif;--dw:400;--dt:-.01em;--ds:1.18;--in-x:-80px;--in-y:0px;--move:cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1);--on-p:#fff;--solid:#16130f;--on-solid:#fffdf8;--shade:#f3ede2d9}

  --display:'JetBrains Mono',monospace;--body:'JetBrains Mono',monospace;--dw:700;--dt:-.05em;--ds:.9;--in-x:0px;--in-y:24px;--move:steps(4,end);--on-p:#031003;--solid:{{secondary}};--on-solid:#031003;--shade:#000000d9}
.t-pop{--ink:#111;--muted:#2c2c2c;--dim:#555;--surface:#fff;--surface2:#fff5d9;--border:4px solid #111;--r:28px;--rs:18px;--shadow:12px 12px 0 #111;--glow:0 0 0 transparent;
  --display:'Bricolage Grotesque',sans-serif;--body:'Bricolage Grotesque',sans-serif;--dw:800;--dt:-.045em;--ds:1.05;--in-x:0px;--in-y:140px;--move:var(--bounce);--on-p:#fff;--solid:#111;--on-solid:#fff;--shade:#ffffffb3}
.root{color:var(--ink);font-family:var(--body)}
.disp{font-family:var(--display);font-weight:var(--dw);letter-spacing:var(--dt)}
.t-paper .disp{font-style:normal}
.t-paper .grad{background:none;-webkit-background-clip:border-box;background-clip:border-box;color:{{primary}};font-style:italic}

.t-pop .grad{background:{{secondary}};-webkit-background-clip:border-box;background-clip:border-box;color:#111;padding:0 .14em;-webkit-box-decoration-break:clone;box-decoration-break:clone}
.t-paper .eyebrow,.t-terminal .eyebrow,.t-pop .eyebrow{color:var(--muted)}

@keyframes pan{from{transform:translateX(0)}to{transform:translateX(-36px)}}

.t-paper .x{animation-name:leaveL}

.t-pop .x{animation-name:leaveDrop}
.t-paper .cam{animation-name:pan}

.t-terminal .r,.t-terminal .p,.t-terminal .ty,.t-terminal .tx,.t-terminal .r3{animation:lift .4s steps(4,end) both,flick .5s steps(5,end) both}
.t-paper .ty,.t-paper .tx,.t-paper .r3{animation:lift .9s var(--move) both,clear .5s var(--out) both}

/* hook: word 1 slams, word 2 widens in beside it and pushes it over */
.typo{position:absolute;inset:0;animation:fadeout .5s ease-in both}
.ey{position:absolute;left:0;width:3200px;top:205px;text-align:center;font-size:34px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.3em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--muted);animation:track 1s var(--out) both}
@keyframes track{from{letter-spacing:1em;opacity:0}}
.kt{position:absolute;left:0;width:3200px;top:280px;text-align:center;font-size:calc(180px * var(--ds));line-height:1.02;white-space:nowrap}
@keyframes slam{from{transform:scale(2.4);opacity:0;filter:blur(14px)}}
.w1{display:inline-block;animation:slam .55s cubic-bezier(.3,0,.2,1) both}
@keyframes widen{from{max-width:0}to{max-width:1600px}}
@keyframes drop{from{transform:translateY(-.6em);opacity:0}}
.w2o{display:inline-block;overflow:hidden;vertical-align:bottom;white-space:nowrap;animation:widen .6s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1) both}
.w2{display:inline-block;padding-left:.22em;animation:drop .6s var(--bounce) both}
.t-terminal .w2::before{content:none}
/* product + odometer */
.od{position:absolute;left:0;width:3200px;top:640px;text-align:center;font-size:calc(150px * var(--ds));line-height:1}
.pn{display:inline-block;animation:lift .8s var(--move) both,clear .5s var(--out) both}
.vn{display:inline-block;margin-left:.35em;padding:.06em .2em;border-radius:var(--rs);background:{{primary}};color:var(--on-p);animation:popIn .6s var(--bounce) both,fadein .2s ease-out both}
.dg{display:inline-block;height:1em;overflow:hidden;vertical-align:top;line-height:1}
.col{display:block;animation:roll 1.5s cubic-bezier(.2,.9,.25,1) both}
.col i{display:block;height:1em;font-style:normal}
@keyframes roll{from{transform:translateY(0)}to{transform:translateY(calc((20 + var(--n)) * -1em))}}
/* the dashboard assembles */
.pc{position:absolute;border-radius:var(--r);background:var(--surface);border:var(--border);box-shadow:var(--shadow);overflow:hidden}
@keyframes fromL{from{transform:translateX(-700px) rotate(-4deg);opacity:0}}
@keyframes fromT{from{transform:translateY(-420px);opacity:0}}
@keyframes fromB{from{transform:translateY(620px) rotate(5deg);opacity:0}}
@keyframes fromR{from{transform:translateX(800px) rotate(4deg);opacity:0}}
.L{animation:fromL .9s var(--spring) both}.T{animation:fromT .8s var(--spring) both}.B{animation:fromB .95s var(--spring) both}.R{animation:fromR .95s var(--spring) both}
.t-terminal .L,.t-terminal .T,.t-terminal .B,.t-terminal .R{animation-timing-function:steps(6,end)}
@keyframes flash{0%{opacity:0;transform:scale(1)}20%{opacity:1}100%{opacity:0;transform:scale(1.04)}}
